name: trader_sell
summary: Sell to the landed trader as the trade window's Sell does: goods come from the pad network's vending machines, then the card holder's inventory; the card is paid. dry_run prices and checks.

help.text: Whole stacks are destroyed and the last one trimmed; gas comes from the pad network's atmosphere. Returns the shape trader_buy returns, with credits_earned and wanted_after per line; delivered is empty. Credits are rounded to the cent.

lines.summary: How lines add up, and selling one entry twice.
lines.text: Each line is checked against what the trader still wants and what is available after the lines before it (goods unit by unit, gas in moles), in a dry run and a real run alike. The lines of one trader entry are sold together in one game call, because the game removes sold stacks and gas only at the end of the frame. A refused line sells nothing: its quantity is 0. In a dry run credits_after is the predicted balance.

credit_card_id.description: The credit card; default the one the player carries.

name.description: The entry's name as trader_inventory gives it; matched first.

prefab_name.description: Breaks a tie between entries of one name, or matches alone.

items.description: Up to 32 lines, each name and/or prefab_name with quantity, traded in order.

dry_run.description: Check and price only; nothing is traded. Default false.
